adrs.title: The repo is a Claude Code plugin, and the skills run the CLI inside it
The approval stamp is `approval.json`, hashing the script's raw bytes
The skills find the CLI with `cd -P` and bootstrap it with `cli/setup.sh`
The look's procedure lives in one file, and waits on `review.md`
Tests skip capture through a test-only option on `main`
A state mark's collision is an `overlap`; an edge through a card is a `crossing`
The CLI reports JSON on stdout, exits 0, 1, 2, 3 or 70, and takes `--pack` by name
A script sits at `explainers/<slug>/` or `local-data/<slug>/`, and renders by fixed name to `local-data/<slug>/render/<pack>/`
The page contract is `?bare`, `seek`, `frameKey`, `DATA` and the frame's data attributes
A style pack is `cli/packs/<name>/pack.json` and its assets, and the player reads these keys
The draft is the script plus a `draft:` block, and Emit validates, moves, then stamps
